LC-9(15)Review of Legal Dash Board /32,) > Date:- 18.12.2015

48 per 2015
To

All Addl. Central P.F Commissioners (Zone)

Subject: - Legal Dashboard User log-in - regarding
Sir,

While reviewing the Legal Dashboard and information furnished by IS
Division, it is found that:

(i) User log-in is still active with reference to the officers, who have
been transferred from that office.

(ii) All OICs/RPFC Legal/APFC Legal/SS Legal have not been provided
the User ID for viewing the Legal Dashboard.

2 In this regard, it is requested to deactivate all such users of the Officers
who have been transferred to other office and all OICs/RPFC Legal/APFC Legal/SS
in Legal Cell should be made users so that they may view the reports on the Legal
Dashboard. Both these tasks can be done by the User Admin of concerned office.

\

Yours faithfully,

(M.P.Varghese)
Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner-I(Legal)
